title: Wake up to their voice.
captionLine: Morning, Hina. Time to wake up.
lead: You pick the time and how often, and their AI clone calls you then: every day, weekdays, weekends or just once. It rings on your lock screen like a real phone call.
note: Depending on your phone’s Focus or Do Not Disturb settings, it may not ring.
costNote: Each morning call uses coins when it’s placed, even if you don’t answer.
voiceTitle: Open Home to their latest voice message.
voiceBody: Play the latest voice message from their AI clone, right from Home. A NEW badge tells you it’s there.
stageAlt: Illustration of a morning call ringing on a lock screen.
